subject: alpine swift
title: This Bird Flew 200 Days Without Landing: It Even Slept in the Air

scenes.text: This bird spends more than half a year without touching the ground.
Scientists strapped tiny sensors to six alpine swifts and followed them from Switzerland to West Africa.
They stayed in the air for about 200 days in a row. No perch. No rest stop.
They caught insects mid-flight and drank and ate in the air.
The sensors suggest they even slept on the wing, gliding while half the brain rested.
So where does a bird that never lands spend the night? Nowhere. The sky is its home.

description:
Alpine swifts were tracked flying about 200 days without landing, from Switzerland to West Africa and back.
They fed on insects mid-flight and appear to have rested on the wing.
Could you go a single day without sitting down?
